note.en: `\tag{1}` is laid out identically, but MathJax 4 splits the tag into one `<mtext>` per character in the assistive MathML while MathJax 3 emits a single `<mtext>(1)</mtext>`; only the MathML text-node representation differs.
note.zh: `\tag{1}` 的排版结果相同，但在辅助 MathML 中 MathJax 4 把标签拆成每个字符一个 `<mtext>`，而 MathJax 3 输出单个 `<mtext>(1)</mtext>`；仅 MathML 文本节点的表示不同。

note.en: The reference delimiter check only rejects spaces and trailing digits, so it parses math next to word characters (`a$x$b`); the current package requires non-word characters around both `$` delimiters so currency and word-embedded dollars stay literal.
note.zh: 参考包的分隔符检查只排除空格和紧随的数字，因此会把紧邻单词字符的 `$` 解析为公式（`a$x$b`）；当前包要求两个 `$` 两侧均为非单词字符，以免货币金额和单词内的 `$` 被解析。

note.en: The reference `$$` block rule emits a display formula even without a closing fence or with trailing content on the line, swallowing the rest of the document/line into the formula; the current package only opens a block when a closing `$$` exists and keeps trailing content as a paragraph.
note.zh: 参考包的 `$$` 块规则在没有闭合围栏或行尾仍有内容时也会输出显示公式，把文档/该行剩余内容吞入公式；当前包只在存在闭合 `$$` 时开启块，并让行尾内容保持为段落。

note.en: The reference inline rule gives up on the whole formula at the first `$` that cannot close (such as a whitespace-surrounded `$` inside `\text{…}`) and leaves the line literal; the current package treats it as literal TeX content and keeps scanning for the closing `$`.
note.zh: 参考包的行内规则在遇到第一个无法闭合的 `$`（例如 `\text{…}` 中被空白包围的 `$`）时就放弃整个公式并保留字面文本；当前包将其视为字面 TeX 内容并继续扫描闭合 `$`。

notes.en: The synchronous entry is compared (`installSyncMathjax`, also exported as `mathjax`): the reference renders synchronously and the async entry of the current package exposes a different API (it takes a MathJax instance instead of plugin options). The sync entry renders MathJax in a worker thread and blocks on one IPC round-trip per document (plus one reset round-trip); the reference typesets in-process through `deasync`.
notes.zh: 对比的是同步入口（`installSyncMathjax`，也以 `mathjax` 导出）：参考包同步渲染，而当前包的异步入口暴露的是另一套 API（它接收 MathJax 实例而不是插件选项）。同步入口在工作线程中渲染 MathJax，并按文档阻塞一次 IPC 往返（外加一次重置往返）；参考包则通过 `deasync` 在进程内排版。

notes.en: `@mdit/plugin-mathjax-slim` keeps `@mathjax/src` and `@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font` as optional peer dependencies and imports them dynamically inside the worker; the session code, options and rendered output are identical to `@mdit/plugin-mathjax`, so the same cases, options and normalization are used for both packages.
notes.zh: `@mdit/plugin-mathjax-slim` 将 `@mathjax/src` 和 `@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font` 保留为可选 peer 依赖，并在 worker 内部动态导入它们；会话代码、选项和渲染输出与 `@mdit/plugin-mathjax` 完全相同，因此两个包使用相同的用例、选项和归一化。

notes.en: Equivalent options: `{ output: "svg" }` (the current default) matches the reference, which only produces SVG. Both sides use `$` / `$$` delimiters only (`delimiters: "dollars"`, `mathFence: false`, `allowInlineWithSpace: false`) and render assistive MathML by default (`a11y: true`). The default `renderStrategy: "batch"` converts every formula of a document (one worker batch), the same number of MathJax conversions as the reference performs per formula.
notes.zh: 等价选项：`{ output: "svg" }`（当前包的默认值）与参考包匹配，后者只生成 SVG。双方都只使用 `$` / `$$` 定界符（`delimiters: "dollars"`、`mathFence: false`、`allowInlineWithSpace: false`），并默认渲染辅助 MathML（`a11y: true`）。默认的 `renderStrategy: "batch"` 会一次转换文档中的所有公式（一个 worker 批次），与参考包逐公式执行的 MathJax 转换次数相同。

notes.en: Normalization: the reference wraps every formula in ` formula `. The id and the inlined CSS are generated per formula (the current package returns the stylesheet once through `getMathjax(md).outputStyle()`), so the wrapper and its template whitespace are normalized away.
notes.zh: 归一化：参考包把每个公式包在 ` formula ` 中。id 和内联 CSS 是按公式生成的（当前包通过 `getMathjax(md).outputStyle()` 只返回一次样式表），因此该包装器及其模板空白会被归一化掉。

notes.en: Normalization: formulas are compared by their assistive MathML instead of the SVG, because the current package renders with MathJax 4 (`@mathjax/src` + the newcm font) while the reference bundles MathJax 3 (`mathxyjax3`'s `tex-svg-full`). SVG paths, widths and `viewBox` values therefore differ by font version by design. Generated `data-*` metadata attributes and presentational `<mstyle>` wrappers are dropped; the MathML tree, its text and MathJax error content stay visible.
notes.zh: 归一化：公式改为比较其辅助 MathML，而不是 SVG，因为当前包使用 MathJax 4（`@mathjax/src` + newcm 字体）渲染，而参考包捆绑的是 MathJax 3（`mathxyjax3` 的 `tex-svg-full`）。因此 SVG 路径、宽度和 `viewBox` 值按设计会因字体版本而不同。生成的 `data-*` 元数据属性和表现性的 `<mstyle>` 包装器会被移除；MathML 树、其文本以及 MathJax 错误内容仍然保留可见。

notes.en: The reference duplicates its whole stylesheet inside every formula (about 4 KiB per formula), which is why its raw output is much larger per formula; that is a known output-size difference of the reference wrapper, not a rendering difference.
notes.zh: 参考包在每个公式中重复整份样式表（每个公式约 4 KiB），这就是它每个公式的原始输出大得多的原因；这是参考包包装器的已知输出体积差异，不是渲染差异。

notes.en: Scaling series: `inline-formulas`, `unmatched-dollars` and `block-fences` check the delimiter scans of the reference (its `math_inline` rescan of `$` candidates and the block loop over `$$` fences); all three fit an exponent near 1 on both sides. `unclosed-block` targets the reference's `math_block` rule: without a closing `$$` it still pushes a display-math token that swallows the rest of the document, so MathJax lays out the whole remaining file as one formula and the measured cost grows superlinearly (fitted exponent ~1.4-1.5), while the current package falls back to a paragraph and stays linear.
notes.zh: 伸缩序列：`inline-formulas`、`unmatched-dollars` 和 `block-fences` 检查参考包的定界符扫描（其 `math_inline` 对 `$` 候选的重新扫描，以及针对 `$$` 围栏的块循环）；三者在双方拟合出的指数都接近 1。`unclosed-block` 针对参考包的 `math_block` 规则：没有结束的 `$$` 时，它仍会推入一个吞掉文档剩余部分的显示公式 token，于是 MathJax 把整个剩余文件排版成一个公式，测得的开销呈超线性增长（拟合指数约 1.4-1.5），而当前包回退为段落并保持线性。
